---
name: Contribution task
about: Define a bounded task with entry points and observable acceptance criteria
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Problem and expected result

Describe the current behavior, a concrete example and the desired outcome.

## Scope and dependencies

List the included changes, prerequisites and work that belongs to another task.

## Entry points

Link the existing modules and owning specification. State the required language,
tools, platform and whether physical hardware is necessary.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The intended workflow works with the identified fixture and configuration.
- [ ] Relevant error, cancellation and recovery cases have been exercised.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implementation, integration and measured support.

## Validation

Provide reproducible commands and expected results. For UI changes, identify
the interaction and before/after evidence needed.

## Difficulty and review

Explain the estimated difficulty and identify a reviewer before inviting work.
Maintainers apply `good first issue` only after confirming the scope is suitable
for a newcomer; broader tasks may use `help wanted`.
